claims.claim: Direct America drive Gearbox for GMC sierra V8 2008 14 15
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a motorcycle engine/frame assembly on the ground; no clear evidence of a GMC Sierra gearbox or any vehicle-specific gearbox identification.
No test/working proof shown in the witness report (no running video, no functional test results).

risks.risk: Item mismatch/scam risk: seller claims a GMC Sierra V8 2008–2015 gearbox, but witness photos show a motorcycle engine/frame assembly.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the gearbox/motor with visible part number/label and a close-up showing it is a gearbox (gear housing, mounting points) plus a photo of the exact item being sold matching the claim.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-matching/uncertain item (worst-case: not the claimed gearbox), treating it as scrap/parts with no guaranteed functionality.

risks.risk: Unknown make/model and compatibility: witness cannot read brand/model; circular component text is not readable.
risks.proof: Request a close-up photo of any stamped/engraved ID, model plate, or readable text on the component(s), and a wider shot showing the full assembly layout.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest compatibility assumption (worst-case: generic/unknown parts value only).

risks.risk: Condition risk: cannot confirm whether it runs, compression status, internal damage, or overheating/cracks.
risks.proof: Request a short video of the engine/assembly running (or a compression test screenshot/record), plus photos of any cracks, burnt wiring, or overheated areas.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested (worst-case: for parts only).

risks.risk: Disassembly/ missing components: witness notes many parts removed/visible; completeness cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Request a photo checklist: show all key components included (carburetor/fuel system, starter, alternator, CDI/ECU/sensors as applicable) and a photo of the full assembled unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete (worst-case: missing critical parts).

risks.risk: Rust/corrosion and structural damage: rust level and cracks are not fully verifiable from a single angle.
risks.proof: Request multiple angles with close-ups of frame/engine block joints, mounting points, and any suspected rust/crack areas under good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming higher wear (worst-case: significant corrosion/possible damage).

proof_requests: Send clear photos that match the seller’s claim: a GMC Sierra V8 2008–2015 gearbox (gear housing, mounting points) with readable part number/label.
Provide a close-up of any identification markings (stamped numbers/plate) on the exact item being sold.
Show whether the item is complete: photos of all included components (starter/alternator/ECU/sensors or gearbox internals as applicable).
Provide proof of condition: a short running video (if engine) or functional test/bench test results (if gearbox), plus any compression/diagnostic report.
response.reason: The witness photos indicate a motorcycle engine/frame assembly, while the seller claims a GMC Sierra V8 gearbox; this mismatch prevents confident pricing. Additional proof is required to confirm the exact item and its condition.
